test_user_dir_path_resolution: test that Paths.user_dir resolves a user_id to the correct users subdirectory path
test_user_memory_file_path: test that Paths.user_memory_file returns the correct memory.json path for a given user
test_user_agent_memory_file_path: test that Paths.user_agent_memory_file resolves the agent memory path and lowercases agent names
test_thread_dir_user_scoped_and_legacy: test that Paths.thread_dir resolves user-scoped or legacy thread directory paths based on user_id
test_sandbox_dirs_and_virtual_path_resol: test that Paths sandbox directory methods and resolve_virtual_path return correct user-isolated paths
